title: Question 1

answer: A process in which reactants form new substances; e.g. 2Mg + O₂ → 2MgO.

title: Question 15
question: State the principle of an electric fuse.
answer: It works on the heating effect of electric current; excess current melts the fuse wire and breaks the circuit.

title: Question 16
question: State Ohm’s law.
answer: At constant temperature, current through a conductor is directly proportional to the potential difference across it: V = IR.

title: Question 18
question: What is the function of the magnetic field around a current-carrying wire?
answer: It exerts magnetic effects and can deflect a compass needle; its direction is given by the right-hand thumb rule.

title: Question 19
question: What is the ozone layer and why is it important?
answer: A region of the stratosphere rich in ozone that absorbs much of the Sun’s harmful ultraviolet radiation.

title: Question 20
question: What is sustainable development?
answer: Development that meets present needs without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs.
